evd_title: CONSORT compliance varied from 35.16 percent in pharmacology to 63.35 percent in urology-nephrology
finding: CONSORT compliance varied from 35.16 percent in pharmacology to 63.35 percent in urology-nephrology
P: 21,041 open-access RCTs from PubMed, stratified by Scimago medical discipline
I: GPT-4o-mini (Azure), zero-shot, one prompt per CONSORT criterion over full text (PDF->XML); 21 of 25 items; high-confidence only
O: Mean % CONSORT items reported: urology/nephrology 63.35% (highest) to pharmacology 35.16% (lowest); radiology 40.46%
